snippet.title: The Long Tale — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Long Tale is a brutal black-and-white platformer where every jump counts and every mistake is final. No checkpoints, no handholding — just pure, honest challenge. Jump, die, rage, repeat, and prove you can survive the castle.

📢 Telegram: @Syrnik_Dev
